```{r Load data}

LPS_T778_HD201.count <- read.delim(file.path(root_dir, "GecKOv2/mageck_count/LPS_T778_HD201.count.txt"))
head(LPS_T778_HD201.count)

library(dplyr)

filtered_df <- LPS_T778_HD201.count %>%
  filter(if_all(3:8, ~ . > 0))  # keep only rows where all counts > 0

filtered_df_sum <- LPS_T778_HD201.count %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(3:8)) > 0) # keep only rows where sum row counts > 0




write_tsv(filtered_df_sum, file.path(root_dir, "GecKOv2/mageck_count/LPS_T778_HD201.count_filter_sum0.txt"))
write_tsv(filtered_df, file.path(root_dir, "GecKOv2/mageck_count/LPS_T778_HD201.count_filter.txt"))

```

# 1 Input data
```{r Load data}
rra_file = file.path(root_dir, "GecKOv2/mageck_test", "LPS_T778_HD201_cnv.rra.gene_summary.txt")
gdata = ReadRRA(rra_file)
genelist = gdata$Score
names(genelist) = gdata$id
genelist = sort(genelist, decreasing = TRUE)
head(genelist)

```
# 2 Enrichment analysis methods

```{r}
# 2.1 Hypergeometric test
# Alternative functions EnrichAnalyzer and enrich.HGT.
hgtRes1 = EnrichAnalyzer(genelist[1:200], method = "HGT", 
                         type = "Pathway", organism = "mmu")
head(hgtRes1@result)

# 2.2 Over-representation test
library(clusterProfiler)
# Alternative functions EnrichAnalyzer and enrich.ORT.
ortRes1 = EnrichAnalyzer(genelist[1:200], method = "ORT", 
                         type = "KEGG", organism = "mmu")
head(ortRes1@result)
```

# 2.4 Visualize enrichment results.
```{r}
# 2.4.1Barplot

require(ggplot2)
df = hgtRes1@result
df$logFDR = -log10(df$p.adjust)
p = BarView(df[1:5,], "Description", 'logFDR')
p = p + labs(x = NULL) + coord_flip()
p
# Or use function barplot from enrichplot package
barplot(hgtRes1, showCategory = 5)

#2.4.2Dot plot
## top: up-regulated pathways; 
## bottom: down-regulated pathways
EnrichedView(hgtRes1, top = 5, bottom = 0, mode = 1)
EnrichedView(hgtRes1, top = 5, bottom = 0, mode = 2)
dotplot(hgtRes1, showCategory = 5)

```
